contract.description: Report store health: active, superseded and tombstoned counts, records per scope, the pendingCompaction backlog, idempotencyConflicts and the gc heartbeat, where stale=true means the sweep is overdue and expired records may be piling up; byTome splits active and tombstoned per tome while counts span the whole store. Call it after a failed memory call to check reachability, or to size the compaction loop before working candidates.

contract.title: Get memory stats
